body:
# Gravity Core

Gravity Core is a cinematic Fabric mod that tears real terrain from the ground and pulls it into a massive floating gravity core.

The mod is built for large visual terrain-pull effects, with staged block removal, animated client-side fragments, and final sphere formation around the core.


## Features

- Pulls real terrain blocks into a gravity core
- Cinematic flying block animation
- Crater-biased surface tearing
- Final gravity core body generation
- Undo command for the latest cast
- Batched client rendering for larger effects

## Commands

```text
/gravitycore
/gravitycore <sizePercent> 
/gravitycore <sizePercent> <durationTicks>
/gravitycore2 ##- Undo command for the latest cast

Requirements
Minecraft 26.1.2
Fabric Loader 0.19.2+
Fabric API
Required on both client and serve

Important Notes
This mod changes real terrain. Back up important worlds before testing large casts.

For multiplayer, the server and all players who want to see the effect must install the mod.
